criteria.criterion: Every git command the driver runs (plan, iterate, gates, preflight) passes -c core.hooksPath=<an empty directory under .vloop/tmp/>, -c core.fsmonitor=false and -c core.quotepath=false; no repository hook or fsmonitor runs on the driver's commits.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/gitguard.go gitCmd recreates an empty .vloop/tmp/nohooks and passes the three -c flags; git(), tracked, commit's diff --cached and workBranch's show-ref all go through it, so refsState does too

criteria.criterion: The driver hashes .git/config and the hooks directory that git rev-parse --git-path hooks names before each session and each gate; a change halts the run with exit 9 and the stderr line `vloop: <phase> changed .git/config — nothing was committed; restore it, then re-run` (or `the git hooks` in place of `.git/config`), and nothing is committed.
criteria.evidence: snapshotGit/changed in gitguard.go; iterate.go checks around the plan, work and review sessions and in runGate (phase gate); plan.go checks around the plan session; message format matches

criteria.criterion: The driver snapshots refs before every gate run, the task's own and every regression gate, and halts with exit 9 and `vloop: the gate of <id> moved git refs — nothing was committed; restore them, then re-run` when they moved.
criteria.evidence: iterate.go runGate takes refsBefore and compares after the run; all gate runs, including the retry and regression ones, go through runGate; haltGit uses ExitRefsMoved

criteria.criterion: The preflight's pre-commit line reads exactly `  ! a pre-commit hook is active (<path>) — the driver's commits do not run repository hooks; put what it checks in the gates`.

cmd/vloop/run_git_test.go holds TestRunHooksPlanted (a work session writes .git/hooks/post-commit creating a branch: exit 9, the branch does not exist), TestRunGitConfigPlanted (a session adds [core] fsmonitor: exit 9) and TestRunGateMovesRefs (verify `git commit --allow-empty -qm x && true`: exit 9, no driver commit); each fails against the base.
criteria.evidence: run_git_test.go has all three, asserting exit 9, the exact stderr line, the absent branch and fsm.ran, and no [vloop] T1 commit. They would fail on the base, which has no guard

criteria.criterion: The checks compare the state of .git/ and the refs before and after, not the commands a session ran (brief: Violations).
criteria.evidence: hashPath of .git/config and the hooks tree, and refsDiff before and after; no command inspection

notes: Other packages (internal/runs, internal/defect, internal/cli) still call raw git, but they are not the driver's commit path and are outside this task's listed files. The gate task list names internal/driver/gates.go, which was not changed; it is not needed because gates.go goes through runGate.
